sentences.text:
======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Harsh Vardhan, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Awadhesh Kumar Singh, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order
2 06-05-2025

Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned APP appearing on behalf of the State.
2.

The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 324, 379, 498A, 376D, 109 and 149 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 66(e) and 67 of the I.T. Act.

3. As per prosecution case, on 19.05.2024 in between 10 AM to 11 AM, all five accused persons,
including this petitioner, entered into the room and on the instigation of co- accused Vivekanand Kushwaha, all of them made her naked and captured her obscene photographs and
committed Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.26943 of 2025(2) dt.06-05-2025 gang rape
. During investigation, the victim in her statement has supported the prosecution case.
4. Considering the specific and direct nature of accusation and statement of victim recorded during course of investigation, the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner is rejected.
